admission.justification: A future review adapter must not fabricate a missing knowledge half or turn unavailable/unselected knowledge into a favorable comparison.

alternatives.option: Compare the selected knowledge subject through the resolved code/memory pair, retaining distinct source-only task context.
alternatives.reason: Appendix151 deliberately keeps paired review and MIK-R50 provides leaf memory. compose_review measures source first, but selected knowledge goes through closed-leaf/pair preflight and the real comparison.

alternatives.option: Invent an unpaired knowledge judgment or an empty missing memory side so a selected subject can appear compared.
alternatives.reason: It would fabricate a knowledge operand/availability observation and erase the legitimate difference from task-context source review.
alternatives.reconsider_when: An approved requirement defines a truthful unpaired knowledge-review operation, its provenance and its unavailable-side semantics.

consequences: A future review adapter must not fabricate a missing knowledge half or turn unavailable/unselected knowledge into a favorable comparison.
No claim that a task-context source review disappears, that legacy-unavailable means an empty converted tree, or that independent requests share one permanent snapshot.
context: Approved MIK-R57@v2 appendix83/151 and rule6 require this by-design choice to be recorded, not deferred as a gap. Source obligation: MIK-R57@v2 by-design paired-review. This is the requirement-prescribed boundary, not a claim that an undocumented alternative was seriously weighed.
decider: Approved MIK-R57@v2 under D18/D47/D48; Curator records the specified boundary under constrains_future_work.
